lead.event: Ultra Jaya schedules a rights issue to fund its Frisian Flag acquisition
lead.headline: ULTJ schedules Rp16.94 trillion rights issue to fund Frisian Flag acquisition
lead.blurb: Ultra Jaya plans to issue 7.88 billion new shares at Rp2,150 each, in a 15,200:11,517 ratio. About 86.01% of the proceeds will fund its planned acquisition of 100% of Frisian Flag Indonesia for Rp14.57 trillion, with the remainder for working capital. FCIH and two other parties will execute 6.77 billion rights, and FCIH will become ULTJ’s controlling shareholder. The cum-right date is 8 January 2027, with new shares due to list on 14 January 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Indonesia’s four largest banks report declining net interest margins in 9M26
earnings_guidance.headline: Indonesia’s largest banks report 9M26 NIM shifts as BMRI falls to 4.21%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s margin fell from 4.59%, while BCA’s declined to 5.41% from 5.76% and BRI’s to 6.16% from 6.53%. BNI’s rose to 3.76% from 3.47%. The banks are focusing on productive lending and low-cost funds, and Bank Mandiri cut its full-year NIM target to 4.3%–4.5% from 4.5%–4.7%.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises its Astra International forecast and target price
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises ASII 2026 profit forecast 5.3% and target to Rp 6,950
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astra International is forecast to earn Rp29.14 trillion, supported by recovering automotive profitability and stable financial services. The analyst maintains a buy recommendation but cuts 2027 and 2028 profit estimates by 2.1% to Rp33.06 trillion and 5.2% to Rp33.70 trillion, respectively, following revisions to United Tractors' outlook.

earnings_guidance.event: Indo Tambangraya Megah reports higher 9M26 revenue and net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: ITMG reports 9M26 revenue and net profit up 17.65% and 24.77%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indo Tambangraya Megah attributed the revenue increase to 5% higher sales volume and a 12% rise in average selling price, which reached US$86 per ton. Sales volume was 18.7 million tons, compared with 17.9 million tons a year earlier.
